headline: The Pakistan Cricket Board has announced central contracts for eight women cricketers for the 2026-27 season, with captain Fatima Sana and Sadia Iqbal in Category A, Geo News reports.

card.desc: Fatima Sana aur Sadia Iqbal Category A mein shamil

caption:
Women cricketers ke liye naye central contracts ka elaan! 🏏
Geo News ke mutabiq PCB ne Friday ko 2026-27 season ke liye 8 women cricketers ko central contracts diye hain, jo 30 June 2027 tak lagu rahenge. Category A mein captain Fatima Sana aur Sadia Iqbal, Category B mein Muneeba Ali Siddiqui, Nashra Sundhu aur Sidra Amin, jabke Category C mein Ayesha Zafar, Gull Feroza aur Sadaf Shamas shamil hain. PCB ke mutabiq categories haaliya performance, form aur fitness ki buniyad par banayi gayi hain, aur players ke fitness test baqaidagi se honge.
Aap ki pasandeeda women cricketer kaun hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
